caption: Distribution of Quantifiers and Operations in Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, Disjunctive Reasoning, and Conjunctive Reasoning.
model_annotation: The three pie charts represent the distribution of different quantifiers and operations across three categories: Categorical, Approximate Number Generation, and Disjunctive & Conjunctive reasoning. The first pie chart, labeled 'Categorical,' contains four slices: Existential Quantifiers (green, 15.12%), Limiter (pink, 27.91%), Negation (orange, 27.91%), and Universal Quantifiers (light blue, 29.07%). The second pie chart, labeled 'Approximate Number Generation,' features three slices: Absolute Absence (light purple, 18.71%), Comparative Relationships (light blue, 36.26%), and Approximate Quantities (cream, 45.03%). The last pie chart, labeled 'Disjunctive & Conjunctive,' includes two slices: Disjunctive (light gray, 49.51%) and Conjunctive (light pink, 50.49%). Each pie chart includes percentage labels displayed within the slices, and they do not contain legends.
